methodology_cautions: Six related-work implementations are common-data adaptations, not exact reproductions of original paper datasets.
Ref.17 and Ref.25 use interaction-provenance approximations; Ref.21 uses role cohorts; Ref.22 adapts co-access groups.
Fig.4 detection latency (ms) is not the same as attack time-to-detect (seconds); only the latter is currently supported.
Fig.5 output is an exploratory event/member-level proxy, not a fair direct comparison of native group-level detectors.
Fig.6/7 templates intentionally contain blank measurements. Do not treat them as experimental results.
--quick uses a reduced dataset and must never be reported as paper results.
